units.source_text: 他被一种诱惑攫住：真想叫那女人一声，对她说几句话。

en.t: He was seized by a kind of temptation: he wanted very much to call out to the woman and say a few words to her.

units.source_text: 他想乘休息之际，点一根香烟试一试。

en.t: He thought he would take the chance while resting to light a cigarette and try it.

units.source_text: 看来塑料袋是这里不可缺少的生活必需品。

en.t: It seemed that plastic bags were an indispensable daily necessity here.

units.source_text: 火柴总算勉勉强强点上火，可香烟简直抽不起来。

en.t: He finally managed, barely, to get the match lit, but the cigarette was almost impossible to smoke.

units.source_text: 他用力吸了一口，两颊的肉都快深深嵌入后牙之间，这才算吸到一点烟味。

en.t: He drew on it hard, until the flesh of his cheeks was nearly sucked deep between his back teeth, and only then did he catch a faint taste of smoke.

units.source_text: 这烟也是油脂味特强，只给舌头带来刺激，决不能算吸烟。

en.t: This tobacco, too, had an especially strong greasy taste; it merely irritated his tongue and could hardly be called smoking.

units.source_text: 那香烟完全破坏了情绪，他休息的时候，再也提不起开口的精神了。

en.t: That cigarette completely ruined the mood, and while he rested he could no longer summon the spirit to speak.
